text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I head to the
racecourse for a
photoshoot in her
signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Great work on the shoot today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Likewise. I appreciate your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
It's nothin', really! I mean, gettin' to
photograph
the Emperor herself? It's an
honor!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Here're the samples from the shoot.
They came
out lookin' pretty nice, if I do
say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When an Umamusume first dons her
signature
racewear, it's customary to
send a photograph to
close relatives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are few greater honors than being
able to wear our finery on the world's
largest stage, so it's
only right to share
that joy with those close to us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With that said, I'm debating whether or
not I
should send a picture to my
parents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's... complicated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I haven't told
you much
about my family, have I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My parents are... passionate and 
uncompromising, shall we say. They work 
themselves to the bone in order to make
the
world a better place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Being their offspring, I am naturally
expected to follow in their footsteps.
They have always held
me to their own
strict standards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To be clear, I don't resent them for it. I
love them
both dearly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My parents gave me a strict upbringing
because
they believe I'm capable of
great things, and for
that, I am grateful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Their parenting inspired me to seek my
purpose
on the track, which is what led
me to Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But, as you know, I still have a long way
to go. I'm
a far cry from the leader they
hope I can become.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So, as I said, it's complicated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They may not be pleased to see me
proudly
dressed in finery when I have
yet to accomplish
anything of note.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Or that's my concern, at any rate. I'm
sorry, it
must be a surprise to see me at
such a loss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah. It's all a matter of framing,
isn't it?
choice_data_list: You can just make it a "progress r...
I'd kind of like to see you get sc...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. I may do just that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If they are dissatisfied with my progress,
so be it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Symboli Rudolf
informs me
that she has received a reply
from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expected, they didn't mince words...
but there was a small expression of
gratitude tacked onto
the end of the
letter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think that even this trifling praise
leaves me struggling to conceal my
happiness... I really do
have a long way
to go.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In any case, thank you for giving me the
push I
needed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but a
weight
seems to have lifted from
Symboli Rudolf's
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You say the oddest things
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, you may well get your wish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I think I will send them the photograph
after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If worst comes to worst, their
disappointment will
sting less if you're
there to share it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Symboli Rudolf
informs me
that she has received a reply
from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expected, they didn't mince words...
but there was a small expression of
gratitude tacked onto
the end of the
letter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dear me. And I had so hoped to treat
you to a
mollified expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet here I find myself smiling instead. So
it goes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I just can't get the better of you,
can I?
choice_data_list: That's a rare expression for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might just be my imagination, but a
weight
seems to have lifted from
Symboli Rudolf's
shoulders.
